queries.query: Chirala Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral-mapping platform and the official Chirala municipal GIS map page. The Bhunaksha page describes a Government of Andhra Pradesh cadastral mapping and geo-referenced spatial-data platform, but its direct host timed out during bounded retrieval; no Chirala parcel API response or safe geometry was obtained.

localCustodian.name: Department of Survey, Settlements and Land Records, Government of Andhra Pradesh
localCustodian.evidence: The official Bhunaksha page identifies itself as the Andhra Pradesh Government Survey, Settlements and Land Records platform and describes cadastral mapping and geo-referenced spatial data. This evidences a state cadastral custodian, but this attempt did not prove a Chirala-specific public layer or endpoint.

cityMap.name: Chirala Municipality official GIS map
cityMap.evidence: The official Chirala municipal page exposes a public GIS map with streets/satellite base layers and Sachivalayam search. Its current JavaScript points to an authenticated external ULB API for Sachivalayam data; no cadastral parcel layer was exposed.

generalAgency.scope: General national land-records and cadastral-map program context; not treated as a Chirala-specific registry or parcel service.
